Trainer Field Guide

Tactical Decision Framework & App Sync

v1.2.0
🎯 1. Catch Screen CP Inspector & Masterball Decisions
Type any wild CP before throwing a ball to cross-reference all 1,401 Pokémon across all 50 levels:
🟣 Level 50 Match: Triggers MASTERBALL ALERT + vibration! Wild level 50 hundos are exceptionally rare mathematical miracles—use a Masterball to guarantee capture.
⭐ Level 40–49 Match: Ultra-rare high-level hundo. Worth your Golden Razz + Ultra Ball curveball.
❌ No Hundo Match: Standard encounter. Save your Masterball and golden berries for higher priorities.
🍇 2. Field Berry Recommendation Matrix
Optimize candy generation while preserving rare berries for raids and high-flee encounters:
🍍 Pinap Berry: Meta staples, trade evolution families, and starter lines where candy volume accelerates power-ups.
🥈 Silver Pinap Berry: Ultra-rare species (Frigibax, Dreepy, Larvesta) and high-CP evolved forms (double candy + catch bonus).
🥇 Golden Razz Berry: Legendaries, Mythicals, Ultra Beasts, and emergency high-flee encounters.
🚫 No Berry: Low utility / common spawns. Save berries to maximize speed-catching efficiency.
📋 3. Post-Event 0–2★ Appraisal Routine (Trade vs Transfer)
Eliminate appraisal paralysis after catching hundreds of Pokémon:
⭐ Trade (Lucky / PvE Meta): Elite raid attackers. Trade to re-roll for Lucky status and save 50% Stardust on maxing.
🍬 Trade (XL Priority): Species requiring Level 50 XL candy for Master or Ultra League. Trading grants guaranteed XL candies.
🔄 Trade (Free Evolution): Machop, Gastly, Timburr, Phantump, etc. Evolving after a trade costs 0 candy!
⚔️ Trade (PvP Re-roll): Top Great/Ultra League species requiring low Attack IVs (0/15/15). Re-roll non-lucky trades.
🗑️ Transfer (Low Utility): Zero PvE or PvP meta relevance. Safe to mass transfer without regret.
⚔️ 4. Moveset Intelligence & Combat Ranks
Tap any card to view exact combat stats:
PvP Moves & Rank: Official PvPoke rankings across Great, Ultra, and Master Leagues.
PvE Cycle DPS: Mathematically optimized attack rotation incorporating Same-Type Attack Bonus (STAB).
Legacy / Elite TM Warnings: Moves requiring an Elite TM are tagged with (Elite) alongside viable non-legacy alternatives.
